# LABELIT — Precision Bottle Labeling
> Precision bottle labeling, custom vessel architecture, and tactile packaging engineering.

## Overview
LABELIT transforms plain glass, metal, and polymer vessels into iconic branded products through micro-tolerance robotic alignment, vacuum registration, and thermal bonding.

## Capabilities
- Custom Labeling: Bespoke die-cut geometries, multi-substrate laminations, and custom adhesive chemistry engineered for unique bottle surfaces.
- Precision Application: Multi-axis robotic positioning calibrated to ±0.1mm tolerance for tapered necks, fluted glass, and irregular vessel contours.
- Short-Run Production: Rapid turnaround boutique runs for single-cask distillers, limited cosmetic drops, and serialized editions.
- Large-Scale Production: Continuous high-throughput industrial lines handling upwards of 25,000 units per hour with automated reel splicing and 100% vision QA.
- Premium Finishes: Heavyweight tactile varnish, micro-embossing, gold leaf hot stamping, holographic security threads, and velvet soft-touch coatings.

## Methodology (The Five-Step Pipeline)
1. Prepare: Deionization and corona flame surface treatment eliminate static and optimize glass surface energy.
2. Align: Multi-point laser registration cameras identify vessel seams and position target axes within ±0.1mm.
3. Apply: Dynamic pneumatic wipe-down rollers apply progressive pressure to purge air and establish uniform adhesion.
4. Inspect: 360-degree machine vision cameras verify barcode grade, margin parallelism, and micro-emboss integrity.
5. Deliver: Robotic collation and padded cellular crating protect labeled vessels during transit.

## Vessel Architecture
- The Alpine Cylinder (Series AL-750): Nordic Minimalist Geometry calibrated for spirits and skincare.
- The Artisan Flask (Series FL-500): Planar front and back surfaces for single malts and luxury fragrances.
- The Modular Prismatic (Series MD-TRIO): Tiered faceted geometry for craft beverages and tonics.
- The Sculptural Prism (Series SC-750): Diamond-facet crystalline architecture.
